subject: HelixCare - trial playbook and executive decision cadence
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@helixcare.com>, Priya Singh <priya.s@helixcare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: HelixCare - trial playbook and executive decision cadence

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we all have alignment before we lock dates.

High-level discovery recap
- Primary goal: reduce clinical documentation time by automating triage & note generation for remote care teams.
- Success metric (trial): 20% reduction in average documentation time across two pilot cohorts, and no more than a 5% drop in clinical accuracy (as measured by HelixCare QA).
- Volume: ~150 weekly consults for pilot cohort A; ~75 weekly for cohort B.

Proposed trial scope & timeline
1) Prep week (Nov 29 - Dec 3): access to 2 weeks of anonymized EHR samples, shared SSO service account, and security questionnaire answer set.
2) Trial execution (Dec 6 - Jan 21): run live inference on shadow mode for cohort A/B; weekly syncs.
3) Evaluation window (Jan 22 - Jan 30): readout, quality review, and final exec decision.

Ownership
- Redwood: Jordan (engagement lead), Ben (solutions engineer lead), Marissa (customer success).
- HelixCare: Daniel (product sponsor), Priya (clinical QA), Oliver (procurement).

Immediate asks for HelixCare
- Confirm target start week (we penciled in Nov 29 prep).
- Provide anonymized sample data and a short list of any PII/PHI transformation rules.
- Share point-of-contact for SSO/service account.

Attachments: HelixCare-trial-proposal-v1.pdf (proposal + SLA assumptions)

If that all looks good I will: (A) share a short tech checklist for Ben to validate infra access, (B) schedule weekly standups, and (C) propose two exec readout slots the week of Jan 26.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(j) 415-555-0142 | jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@helixcare.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.s@helixcare.com>, Oliver Reed <oliver.reed@helixcare.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 13:28:00 -0500
Subject: Re: HelixCare - trial playbook and executive decision cadence

Jordan — thanks for the clear recap. This aligns with our internal view. A few quick items: 

- Nov 29 prep week works but can we shift to Dec 6 if the Redwood team needs a full week of lead time? Procurement has a shorter lead on our side for final access approvals.
- We will need a SOC 2 summary and confirmation about data retention (how long cached data remains in Redwood logs). Priya will validate the 5% accuracy tolerance with the clinical team.
- Procurement (Oliver) asked if you can share a draft SoW or SOW template we can attach to internal approval tickets.

I'll aim to get sample data and the SSO contact to you by next Wed (Nov 11).

Thanks — Daniel
Daniel Park | Head of Product, HelixCare
daniel.park@helixcare.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: RE: HelixCare - trial playbook and executive decision cadence

Jordan / Ben — quick internal note following Daniel's reply. A few adjustments I recommend before we send the technical checklist out: 

1) Move prep week to Dec 6 (to match HelixCare's procurement window).
2) Tighten success criteria language in the proposal: replace "20% reduction" with "target 20% reduction (primary), with secondary metric: 95th percentile turnaround time reduction" — keeps execs focused on tail latency.
3) Line up an internal pre-read for the exec slot: one-pager (KPIs + callouts) due Jan 20 so we have time to iterate.

Monica — can you coordinate a short SoW template and confirm whether standard Redwood retention settings (30 days) are acceptable or whether we need to propose an alternative for HelixCare?

Ben — once we confirm Dec 6 start, please drop the access checklist and test plan. I'd like us to own weekly sync facilitation until handoff to CS post-readout.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Customer Success Manager
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: RE: HelixCare - trial playbook and executive decision cadence

All — attaching a lightweight tech-eval checklist and a proposed test plan (tech-eval-checklist.xlsx). Highlights: 
- Required: SSO service account + API key (scoped to read-only sample set), sample payloads (anonymized), and a test user cohort list.
- Shadow mode config to avoid production logs being written back into HelixCare EHR; logs will be captured in a temporary sandbox bucket with 30-day lifecycle (we can adjust if needed).
- Owner matrix included (who on Redwood will validate model outputs each week).

I'll be available for a kickoff on Dec 6. If HelixCare wants a dry-run of the deploy earlier, we can schedule a short window on Dec 3 (limited).

-Ben
Ben Carter | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: tech-eval-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Finalized plan & exec readout slots (HelixCare trial)

Daniel / Priya / Oliver — putting the agreed plan in writing and proposing two exec readout windows so you can reserve time: 

Finalized timeline (per HelixCare ask) - Prep week: Dec 6 - Dec 10 (redwood team does infra checks and Ben validates sample access) - Trial execution: Dec 13 - Jan 21 (live shadow inference; weekly syncs on Fridays) - Internal QA & readout prep: Jan 22 - Jan 25

Exec readout (decision meeting) — pick one:
- Option A: Tue Jan 27, 2027 @ 10:00 - 11:00 PT
- Option B: Thu Jan 29, 2027 @ 14:00 - 15:00 PT

Decision path: after the readout HelixCare execs will confirm go/no-go; if go, we will issue a draft SoW and contract addendum and open the procurement queue (Oliver). To keep timeline tight we will circulate the one-pager pre-read on Jan 20.

Next steps for HelixCare (action items)
- Confirm preferred exec slot (Option A or B) by Fri Nov 19.
- Deliver anonymized sample data and SSO contact by Wed Nov 11 (Daniel indicated this is likely).
- Confirm any retention exceptions for sandbox logs (Monica raised default 30 days).

I will upload the combined materials to the shared folder and send a DocuSign SoW template once we have exec slot and confirmation of the start dates. Links below: HubSpot deal, Drive folder, and placeholder DocuSign.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to getting started.
